Fixed virtual_core (deadline = now + lease at generation; response_sent renews nothing), the five checkers and their mutant tests (send_time / send_renew / no_generation_renew replace the old 'no send renewal' mutants), endpoint.handle (_lapse before header/resend), docs. Added test_the_lease_restarts_at_the_answers_generation_not_its_write (+ mutant), test_a_new_owners_lease_starts_at_its_open_answer_and_an_ended_session_is_never_renewed, test_an_expired_lease_is_cleaned_up_before_the_next_request_even_a_resend[core-v1/full], and named the rewritten test_conformance_lease / writer_lease tests.
